headline: Onesource Specialty Pharma gets USFDA EIR with VAI classification for Bengaluru facility
hook: USFDA clearance for Bengaluru sterile plant
summary: Onesource Specialty Pharma has announced that its Sterile Product Division facility in Bengaluru received an Establishment Inspection Report from the US FDA with a Voluntary Action Indicated classification. This classification marks the successful completion of the inspection process for the site. For an Indian retail investor holding the stock, this regulatory clearance removes a compliance overhang and paves the way for commercial progress at the sterile product unit.
whats_next: Commercial rollout updates from the Bengaluru facility
why_it_matters: Regulatory clearance removes facility overhang for Onesource holders

headline: OneSource Specialty Pharma shares surge 14% on strong Q2 results and maintained guidance
hook: Strong quarter fuels sharp stock rebound
summary: OneSource Specialty Pharma shares jumped nearly 14% after reporting a 37% year-on-year growth in Q2 revenue and an adjusted profit after tax of ₹93.7 crore. The company also maintained its FY28 targets, backed by plans to expand drug-device combination capacity. This strong performance has helped the stock recover 50% from its recent lows. Retail investors tracking pharmaceutical counters gain insight into the company's growth momentum and capacity expansion plans.
whats_next: FY28 target milestones and capacity expansion updates
why_it_matters: Strong Q2 earnings drive sharp recovery in OneSource shares
winners_losers: OneSource shareholders gain / recent sellers hurt

headline: Onesource Specialty Pharma posts 37 percent rise in Q2 revenue
hook: Strong growth reported in second quarter
summary: Onesource Specialty Pharma Limited has released its financial results for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. The company reported a 37 percent year-on-year increase in revenue. EBITDA also grew by 53 percent compared to the same period last year. Indian retail investors tracking specialty pharma stocks should note the margin expansion.
why_it_matters: Earnings growth boosts sentiment for Onesource Specialty Pharma shareholders

headline: Onesource Specialty Pharma stock jumps 8 percent following Q2 results
hook: An 8 percent jump on steady operations
summary: Onesource Specialty Pharma shares rose 8 percent following its Q2 results driven by strong operating performance and revenue growth. The stock began trading on the bourses in January 2025 at ₹1,800 per share, which was 6.9 percent compared to its pre-open discovery price. Despite the recent bounce, the stock remains down 23 percent from its recent 52-week high of ₹1,925. Retail investors tracking specialty pharma stocks should note the operational recovery in recent earnings.
why_it_matters: Operating performance lifts Onesource shares despite trailing 52-week highs.
